addition.item: CaptchaFox as captcha for Joomla 5.4 and Joomla 6
Protects the contact form, user registration, "Forgot your username?", "Forgot your password?" and article submission
Options for mode (inline, popup, hidden), theme, start and language
Server-side verification; if CaptchaFox is unreachable, forms are let through and the outage is logged by default (configurable)
